user.title: Add food container
user.description: Scan the QR code on the container (e.g. with a shortcut) and paste its content here. Alternatively the ID alone is enough (value of `cc`, e.g. `34OL`).

error.invalid_code: No valid ID (cc) found in the QR code.

abort.already_configured: This container has already been added.

content_entity_missing.message: The "Contents" entity of this container is not available (disabled?).

init.title: Scan webhook
init.description:
Enter this URL **once** in the iOS shortcut. It is secret: anyone who knows it can look up containers.

`{webhook_url}`

Path only: `{webhook_path}`

See the project README for the shortcut instructions.
